mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing overcast skies and a temperature of 65 degrees around Badger Prairie County Park, with a waning gibbous moon tonight.

In city news, a portion of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 6th through October 9th for final paving and shoulder work. Also, early in-person absentee voting begins at City Hall on Tuesday, October 20th.

There are several local activities today, including yoga at Insight Wellness and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market. Looking ahead to tomorrow, Hop Haus Brewing is hosting trivia and Art House 360 has its first Art Bar Happy Hour.

In police news, on Thursday, September 24th, officers responded to Westward Drive where an eleven-year-old bicyclist collided with a vehicle after failing to stop at a stop sign, but thankfully did not require hospitalization.
To wrap things up, Culver's is open until 10 PM today featuring Double Strawberry as the flavor of the day. Tomorrow's featured flavor will be Chocolate Heath Crunch starting at 10 AM.
